description: This file defines a React functional component 'BackendHealthCheck' that performs periodic health checks on a backend API. It manages state for health status, error messages, and retry logic, and renders UI elements based on the backend's availability. It also imports external API configuration and React hooks.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the backend health endpoint and updates component state based on the response.

methods.name: handleRetry
methods.description: Increments the retry count to trigger a re-check of backend health.
